Name: Dee's Nuts A Chestnut Expansion
Author: DustNugget
Description:
[b][size=4]Dee's Nuts - A Chestnut Expansion[/size]
[/b]
[b]Dee's Nuts[/b] adds a comprehensive new Chestnut tree and bakery expansion to Stardew Valley. It's not just a new crop; it's a fully integrated production chain that fits seamlessly into the vanilla game.

From roasting nuts by the fire to grinding flour for artisan bread, this mod breathes new life into the Fall season!

🌰[b][size=3] Features[/size][/b]
[b]The Tree[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Chestnut Saplings:[/b] Available at [b]Pierre’s General Store[/b] (6,000g).
[*][b]Growth:[/b] Takes 28 days to mature. Plant them in Spring or Summer!
[*][b]Harvest:[/b] Produces [b]Chestnuts[/b] every day during [b]Fall[/b].
[/list][b]The Kitchen & Processing[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Roasted Chestnuts:[/b] A cozy winter snack. Linus will send you the recipe if you're friends!
[*][b]Chestnut Flour:[/b] Dry your chestnuts in a [b]Dehydrator[/b] and [b]bash 'em up in the kitchen [/b]to create a sweet, gluten-free flour.
[*][b]Chestnut Bread:[/b] A high-energy mining food (+2 Mining Buff). Jodi might share her secret family recipe with you...
[/list][b]The World[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Immersive Mail:[/b] Receive seasonal newsletters from Pierre, Linus, and Jodi introducing the new items.
[*][b]NPC Tastes:[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Linus & Leah[/b] LOVE Roasted Chestnuts.
[*][b]Jodi, Gus, & Evelyn[/b] LOVE Chestnut Bread.
[*](Most other villagers Like them!)
[/list][/list]🔧 Installation[list=1]
[*]Install [b][url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url][/b].

[*]Install [b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url][/b].

[*]Download this mod and unzip it into your [code]Stardew Valley/Mods[/code] folder.

[*]Run the game!

[/list]❓ FAQ

[b]Does this work with 1.6?[/b]Yes, it was built specifically for Stardew Valley 1.6!
[b]
Where do I get the flour?
[/b]You have two options:
[list=1]
[*][b]Dehydrator:[/b] Put 1 Chestnuts in a Dehydrator -> Get Dried Chestnuts.

[*][b]Kitchen:[/b] Use the Chestnut Flour recipe in your recipes at the stove in your kitchen with your Dried Chestnuts, to make Chestnut Bread!
[/list]
